message.text: I am building the line map first: upload an image, compare it with white-and-black line art, and tune four sliders. No minions; all pool worktrees are currently held, so I am preparing the filter and checking existing page patterns until one returns.
A pool worktree is now available, and the build is underway. The first checks already show a faint straight seam scoring above loud random texture; the page will let you compare the result yourself.

The first version is committed: four samples, image upload/drop, four sliders and PNG download. Visual verification is temporarily blocked because the pool's test server is unavailable; Servex is restoring it while I finish the numerical tests and docs.
